nodes.description: Public mint price in wei (0.03 ETH) used in mintDoggos payment check.
Maximum supply constant (4000) enforced in mintInternal.
Mutable nonce incremented inside hash() to diversify pseudo-random input.
Mapping tracking already minted trait hashes to prevent duplicates.
Mapping from tokenId to its generated trait hash string.
Mapping of trait index to array of Trait structs used for metadata/SVG rendering.
Fixed 8x uint16 array of rarity tier percentage weights.
Alphabet array used by letterToNumber for pixel coordinate lookup.
Ownable owner address controlling privileged functions.
Contract constructor: sets name/symbol, initializes rarity TIERS, sets deployer as owner.
Internal view that maps a 0-10000 value to a trait index string based on TIERS bounds.
Internal recursive hash generator using block.timestamp, block.difficulty and SEED_NONCE as entropy.
Internal mint routine: supply cap check, EOA check on msg.sender, hash generation and _mint call.
Public payable mint entrypoint validating count against price and total supply.
Owner-only function transferring the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
Internal helper converting a letter to its 1-based alphabet index for pixel placement.
Public view rendering the on-chain SVG image from a token hash and trait pixel data.
Public view building the JSON attributes metadata string from trait data.
Public view returning base64 data URI combining metadata and SVG for a token.
Public view returning the stored trait hash for a tokenId with burned-token override.
Owner-only function deleting all trait type entries.
Owner-only function appending trait structs to a given trait type index.
Owner-only function transferring contract ownership to a new address.
Internal ownership transfer updating the _owner state variable.
Modifier enforcing that the caller equals the stored owner.
Caller-controlled address used for minting recipient, ownership checks and withdrawal.
Miner-influenced timestamp consumed as entropy by the hash function.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) external value transfer in withdraw.
ERC721 _mint call issuing a new token to the untrusted caller-derived recipient.
keccak256 over block.timestamp, block.difficulty and SEED_NONCE used as pseudo-randomness.
Caller-supplied mint quantity parameter of mintDoggos.
Cached totalSupply() value inside mintInternal used for cap check and token id.
Newly assigned token id inside mintInternal derived from total supply.
0-10000 rarity input parameter of rarityGen.
Accumulated hash string built iteratively inside hash().
Cached contract balance inside withdraw that is sent out.
Trait type index parameter of addTraitType selecting destination array.
Accumulated SVG markup string inside hashToSVG.

edges.reason: mintInternal reads msg.sender both as EOA filter and as mint recipient, giving the caller control over the minted token recipient.
withdraw sends the whole contract balance to msg.sender (owner), caller identity drives fund destination.
mintDoggos is payable and the caller supplies msg.value checked against price.
hash() uses block.timestamp as entropy, making trait generation miner-manipulable (timestamp dependency).
hash() increments and reads SEED_NONCE on each iteration.
hash() reads hashToMinted to detect duplicate hashes and recurse with a new nonce.
hash() calls rarityGen to convert each random digit into a trait index.
rarityGen reads TIERS to resolve rarity bounds.
hash() feeds timestamp/nonce values into the keccak256 pseudo-random generator.
mintInternal compares current supply against MAX_SUPPLY cap.
mintInternal invokes hash() to generate the token trait hash.
mintInternal writes the generated hash into tokenIdToHash.
mintInternal marks the generated hash as minted in hashToMinted.
mintInternal executes the ERC721 _mint state-changing operation.
mintDoggos loops calling mintInternal for each requested token.
mintDoggos validates msg.value against _times * price, an arithmetic relation on mint quantities.
withdraw is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw performs an external value transfer of the full balance to the caller.
onlyOwner compares owner() with msg.sender to gate privileged functions.
addTraitType is guarded by onlyOwner.
clearTraits is guarded by onlyOwner.
clearTraits deletes entries of the traitTypes mapping.
addTraitType pushes new Trait structs into traitTypes.
constructor transfers initial ownership to the deployer via _transferOwnership(_msgSender()).
_transferOwnership writes the new owner into the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership delegates the state update to _transferOwnership.
tokenURI fetches the token hash through _tokenIdToHash.
tokenURI renders the image by calling hashToSVG.
tokenURI builds attributes by calling hashToMetadata.
_tokenIdToHash reads the stored hash from tokenIdToHash.
hashToSVG reads trait pixel data from traitTypes.
hashToMetadata reads trait names/types from traitTypes.
hashToSVG calls letterToNumber to convert pixel letters into coordinates.
_mint targets a caller-controlled recipient; if that recipient is a contract its receive/ERC721 hooks can reenter before mint state is finalized.
Caller-controlled _times multiplies the price to compute the required msg.value.
Local _totalSupply caches totalSupply() for the supply cap check in mintInternal.
Local thisTokenId becomes the id of the token created by the _mint operation.
Local parameter _randinput drives the tier comparison inside rarityGen.
Local currentHash accumulates the generated trait digits inside hash().
Local balance is the full contract balance forwarded by the external transfer in withdraw.
Local parameter _traitTypeIndex selects which traitTypes array receives pushed traits.
Local svgString accumulates the rendered markup returned by hashToSVG.

normalization_plan.reason: _times is a caller-supplied parameter local to mintDoggos and has no standalone semantic identity.
_totalSupply is a transient local cache inside mintInternal representing the current ERC721 supply.
thisTokenId exists only to be consumed by the _mint unsafe operation.
_randinput is an internal parameter exclusively consumed by rarityGen's tier resolution logic.
currentHash is a loop accumulator local to the hash() trait generation routine.
balance is only read to be forwarded by the external transfer in withdraw.
_traitTypeIndex is a parameter used solely to index the traitTypes array within addTraitType.
svgString is a construction buffer local to hashToSVG with no independent semantics.
